# Mackenzie Apartments Mombasa

> Furnished waterfront apartments for long-term rent, set in tropical gardens on Tudor Creek, by Nyali Bridge, Mombasa, Kenya. Studios, one, two and three-bedroom apartments in a private gated community with two swimming pools, a gym and a private jetty. Owner-managed by the Mackenzie family for 40 years, since 1986. The family lives on site.

## Key facts

- Location: Ras Kisauni Road, by Nyali Bridge, Mombasa, Kenya (Nyali side of the bridge, on Tudor Creek)
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=11285151965640191086 (rated 4.8 on Google)
- Apartments: studio, 1 bedroom, 2 bedroom and 3 bedroom; all fully furnished (furniture, kitchen, beds and linen), every bedroom en-suite, equipped kitchen, air conditioning and ceiling fans, Wi-Fi
- Renting: long-term rentals only. Pricing and availability are shared on request by WhatsApp or email
- On site: two swimming pools, residents' gym (bikes, weights, rowing machines), decks by the water, private jetty and boat moorings, tropical gardens, covered parking
- Security and services: private gated community, 24-hour security, standby generators covering the whole property, own fresh-water supply all year, on-site management, owners living on site
- Marina: pontoon moorings for boats up to 30 ft, open to residents and to outside boat owners
- Nearby by car: China Square 4 min, Nyali Cinemax 5 min, The Mombasa Hospital 11 min, Aga Khan Academy 11 min, Old Town and Fort Jesus 12 min, Nyali Golf and Country Club 12 min, Nyali Beach 14 min, City Mall and Carrefour 20 min, Moi International Airport 20 min, SGR station 25 min
- Viewings: most days, arranged by WhatsApp
- Contact: WhatsApp +254 700 932 020, email dempoffice@gmail.com, Instagram @mackenzieapartmentsmombasa, Facebook /Mackenzieapartmentsmombasa

## Good fit for

- People relocating to Mombasa for work who want a furnished home for months or years
- Families who want space, gardens, pools and security close to Nyali schools and hospitals
- Boat owners who want to live by their mooring on Tudor Creek

## Frequently asked

- Pricing? Ask on WhatsApp +254 700 932 020 or by email; availability and prices are shared on request.
- Fully furnished? Yes: furniture, kitchen, beds and linen.
- Viewings? Yes, most days, by WhatsApp.
- Power cuts and water? Standby generators cover the whole property; own fresh-water supply all year.
- Boats? Yes, pontoon moorings up to 30 ft.
- Safe? Private gated community, 24-hour security, owners on site.
